description: This file contains unit tests for the BbrSender congestion control algorithm in QUIC, including tests for transfer behavior, state transitions, bandwidth estimation, and recovery scenarios.

classes.name: BbrSenderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BbrSender congestion control, setting up network simulations and testing various behaviors.

methods.name: SetupBbrSender
methods.description: Enables BBR on a given endpoint and returns the associated BBR congestion controller.

methods.name: CreateDefaultSetup
methods.description: Sets up a network with a bottleneck between receiver and switch with buffers sized to avoid losses.

methods.name: CreateSmallBufferSetup
methods.description: Sets up a network with a smaller buffer size to test behavior under constrained conditions.

methods.name: CreateCompetitionSetup
methods.description: Creates a network setup with two competing senders for the same bottleneck.

methods.name: CreateBbrVsBbrSetup
methods.description: Sets up a competition between two BBR flows.

methods.name: EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables aggregation of packets on a specified path.

methods.name: DoSimpleTransfer
methods.description: Transfers a specified amount of data within a deadline, asserting success.

methods.name: DriveOutOfStartup
methods.description: Drives the congestion control out of startup phase into probe bandwidth.

methods.name: SendBursts
methods.description: Sends bursts of data with waits in between, simulating application bursts.

methods.name: SetConnectionOption
methods.description: Sets specific connection options for testing different behaviors.
